# LED & power calculations (generated by led_power_calc.py)

Model: I = (V_cell − Vf) / (R + r_d), Vf = 2.75 V (estimate at ~1.5 mA), r_d = 60 Ω, 3 LEDs each with its own resistor.

## Per-LED current (mA) vs cell voltage and resistor

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 330 | 3.08 | 2.44 | 1.67 | 0.90 | 3.124 |
| 470 | 2.26 | 1.79 | 1.23 | 0.66 | 2.409 |

## Runtime estimate (all LEDs on)

Usable capacity assumed: 30 mAh × 0.80 = 24.0 mAh

| R (Ω) | total current @3.7 V (mA) | runtime (h) | LED power (mW) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 330 | 7.31 | 3.3 | 27.0 |
| 470 | 5.38 | 4.5 | 19.9 |
| 680 | 3.85 | 6.2 | 14.3 |
| 1000 | 2.69 | 8.9 | 10.0 |
| 1500 | 1.83 | 13.1 | 6.8 |

Standby drain with switch OFF ≈ 3.0 µA → 333 days from full (self-discharge of the cell will dominate; recharge monthly).

## Charging (charger lives in the cradle)

* MCP73831 R_PROG = 66.5 kΩ → I_REG = 1000/66.5 = **15.0 mA** (device minimum is 15 mA).
* C-rate for a 30 mAh cell = 0.50 C (must be ≤ the cell's max charge rate, typically 0.5–1 C; check the cell datasheet).
* **Do not use a cell smaller than ~30 mAh** with this charger setting (would exceed 0.5 C).
* Series Schottky in the ring (reverse-short protection on the exposed contacts) means the cell terminates near 4.20 − 0.25 ≈ 3.95 V (~80–85 % capacity). This is deliberately conservative.
* Approx. charge time from empty: CC phase ≈ 1.7 h + CV taper ≈ 0.5–1 h → **~2.4 h**.
* Datasheet termination/preconditioning tables are specified for R_PROG 2–10 kΩ; at 66.5 kΩ termination behaviour must be verified on the bench (test CHG-02).
